authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored conventional recorder/package and manual parameterization, not this demo. Same-team reporting review, not external or blinded evaluation.
scope: Read-only review of buyer action, finite component scope, EN/FR claims, complete-cost uncertainty and recorded QA. No browser or consumer probes, no frozen/demo/paper edits.

findings.evidence: Both languages name RequestBoundary and enumerated Mission/Review/Control inputs, original FastAPI import path and real 15-second timeout; positive action advances component evidence while preserving the native lock pending complete application/release qualification.

Three cost cards explicitly show Unknown/Inconnu; collections are zero. Resource intros distinguish recorded execution resources from unidentified prices/effort. Price, customer savings, payback, available cash, obligations/reserves and approved allocation remain unidentified.

Six distinct historical missions, two package clusters, three equally accepted arms, explicit 6/0/0 finalizations; A service span includes response/scheduling, not no-AI active work. C matches accepted quality. No eventual-output or algorithmic-superiority claim.

Development is labeled exposed; confirmation is historical representative work. No observed maintainer/customer acceptance, payment, production reliability or primary dependency regression is claimed.

Evidence ZIP and technical JSON are distinct from the full companion with wheels/offline reconstruction. Existing browser QA has14 language/mission combinations and2 actual ZIP downloads; both downloaded hashes match the current sealed data. Recorded verification finds exact original manifest and added supporting files valid.

Actual components and next action are visible before downloads. French cost introduction now refers explicitly to known execution resources and unknown costs, closing the earlier compact-engine clarity gap without replacing original packets.

limitations: This review reads the recorded browser/download QA; it did not independently rerun those interactions.
Standalone packet downloads require the full companion for offline environment reconstruction.
Static sealed content review does not establish production service availability, customer acceptance or complete cost.
